en.bdb: Guru in the form of a tree

verses.gurmukhi: ਇਕੁ ਸਿਖੁ ਦੁਇ ਸਾਧ ਸੰਗੁ ਪੰਜੀਂ ਪਰਮੇਸਰੁ।
verses.translit_en: eik sikh dhui saadh sa(n)g pa(n)jee(n) paramesaru|

en.bdb: One is a Sikh, two the congregation and in five resides God.

verses.gurmukhi: ਨਉ ਅੰਗ ਨੀਲ ਅਨੀਲ ਸੁੰਨ ਅਵਤਾਰ ਮਹੇਸਰੁ।
verses.translit_en: nau a(n)g neel aneel su(n)n avataar mahesaru|

en.bdb: As cyphers added to one make the infinite number, likewise getting attached with Sunya (God), the creatures also transform into great men and kings of the earth.

verses.gurmukhi: ਵੀਹ ਇਕੀਹ ਅਸੰਖ ਸੰਖ ਮੁਕਤੈ ਮੁਕਤੇਸਰੁ।
verses.translit_en: veeh ikeeh asa(n)kh sa(n)kh mukatai mukatesaru|

en.bdb: In this way innumerable small and big persons also become liberated and liberators.

verses.gurmukhi: ਨਗਰਿ ਨਗਰਿ ਮੈ ਸਹੰਸ ਸਿਖ ਦੇਸ ਦੇਸ ਲਖੇਸਰੁ।
verses.translit_en: nagar nagar mai saha(n)s sikh dhes dhes lakhesaru|

en.bdb: In town after town and country after country are myriads of Sikhs.

verses.gurmukhi: ਇਕ ਦੂੰ ਬਿਰਖਹੁ ਲਖ ਫਲ ਫਲ ਬੀਅ ਲੋਮੇਸਰੁ।
verses.translit_en: eik dhoo(n) birakhahu lakh fal fal beea lomesaru|

en.bdb: As millions of fruits are obtained from a tree and in those fruits remain millions of seeds (In fact the Sikhs are the fruits of the Guru-tree and in those fruits the Guru resides in the form of seeds).

verses.gurmukhi: ਭੋਗ ਭੁਗਤਿ ਰਾਜੇਸੁਰਾ ਜੋਗ ਜੁਗਤਿ ਜੋਗੇਸਰੁ ॥੧੯॥
verses.translit_en: bhog bhugat raajesuraa jog jugat jogesar ||19||

en.bdb: These disciples of the Guru being enjoyers of delights are the emperors of the kings and being knower of the technique of yoga are kings of yogis.
